name: recoil_app_mission_fmv_on_deactivate
description: RecoilApp_MissionFmvState::OnDeactivate clears the latched mission id and rewinds the mission FMV script when playback was active.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target currently covers this RecoilApp mission-FMV state method.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly and HLIL for 0x42ee50 show m_skipMissionFmv read before m_missionId is cleared, then zFMV_Script::BeginNow(&m_fmv, 1) only when the saved skip value is zero.

The native smoke verifies the skipped branch clears mission id without changing the embedded FMV cursor, and the active branch clears mission id and rewinds the embedded FMV action cursor through BeginNow(1).
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x42ee50 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
